name: Before After Slider
author: musaraeeskhan

sections.description:
Before After Slider is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that allows you to create stunning before and after image comparison sliders.

You can choose from multiple slider styles and display them anywhere using a simple shortcode.

Features:
– Unlimited before/after sliders
– 7 different slider styles
– Mobile responsive
– Easy admin panel
– Media uploader support
– Lightweight & fast

Usage

Use the shortcode below to display the slider anywhere on your site:

[musaba_slider]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from WordPress dashboard
  3. Go to Before After Slider settings
  4. Add images and use shortcode
sections.faq:
Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, it works perfectly on all devices.

Can I add multiple sliders?

Yes, you can add unlimited sliders.

Does it require coding knowledge?

No, it is beginner friendly and works without any coding.

Can I use horizontal and vertical sliders?

Yes, both horizontal and vertical comparison layouts are supported.

Is the plugin compatible with all themes?

Yes, it works with all modern WordPress themes.

Can I use the slider with shortcodes?

Yes, you can easily display sliders anywhere using shortcodes.

Is the plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes, it is optimized for performance and loads quickly.
